sources.title: Beijing Foreign Studies University 2026 international undergraduate admissions prospectus
Beijing Foreign Studies University 2026 international undergraduate program catalog

requirements.ruleText: Hold a valid ordinary foreign passport and qualify as a non-Chinese citizen under the published nationality rules.
Meet the published physical and mental health standard, have no criminal record or public-security penalty, comply with Chinese law and university rules, and be able to complete on-campus study.
Complete senior high school education; applicants under 18 must also satisfy the published guardian-document rules.
Complete the BFSU online application with truthful, accurate, complete and valid information.
Submit the senior high-school graduation certificate; current students may use an enrollment certificate and must provide the original diploma before registration.
Submit official academic transcripts in Chinese or English, adding a notarized Chinese or English translation when required.
Submit the official CSCA result with the exact subjects published for the selected program.
Submit a valid Chinese or English language certificate that meets the selected school's and program's published requirement; the captured sources do not publish one universal score threshold.
Submit a personal statement of at least 500 words in the selected program's teaching language.
Submit a clear scan of the ordinary passport biographical page and the additional residence/entry or nationality records required by the applicant's circumstances.
Submit the applicant-signed admission commitment and the sponsor-signed guarantee using the official templates.
Submit the employer's consent-to-study letter or proof that the employment relationship has ended.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants whose school, scholarship or academic background requires them
requirements.ruleText: Submit the additional school or scholarship documents and any published academic output requested by BFSU.
Pay the non-refundable CNY 800 online application fee in RMB.
Submit the autumn application by June 15, 2026.

sources.title: East China University of Science and Technology 2026 international undergraduate admissions
East China University of Science and Technology 2026 international undergraduate program catalog

requirements.ruleText: Hold a valid foreign passport, be in good health and comply with the published nationality rules.
Hold a high-school diploma or higher and be over age 16; applicants under 18 before August 31 must submit the official guarantee statement.
Submit TOEFL 80, IELTS 6.0 or Duolingo 105, unless a published native-English or prior English-medium-degree exemption applies.
Register once in the ECUST online application system and submit the required documents according to the system prompts.
Submit the passport photo page, valid through September 1, 2027 or later.
Submit the high-school diploma or equivalent; prospective graduates submit current study status and expected graduation date, then the diploma before registration.
Submit all high-school transcripts or published international standardized-test results.
Submit CSCA results for the exact subjects listed for the selected program.
Submit a study plan of at least 800 words covering the applicant, family, reasons for choosing ECUST and the major.
Submit a non-criminal-record certificate or the published alternative applicable to the applicant's situation.
Submit the Statement of Financial Support.
Submit the Foreigner Physical Examination Form or the published in-China residence-document substitute; the examination result is valid for six months.
Pay the non-refundable CNY 600 application fee.

references.locator: Application Procedures and Study Term and Fees
